body_lead: Gujarat Police Innovation Challenge 2026: Winning teams awarded ?18 lakh; focus on AI-driven smart policing The valedictory ceremony of the ‘Gujarat Police Innovation Challenge 2026’ (Sentinel Hackathon 2026) concluded at i-Hub in Ahmedabad , marking a significant milestone in the integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and CCTV infrastructure for public safety. The two-day event, described as India’s largest AI-CCTV hackathon, saw enthusiastic participation from innovators, startups, and researchers nationwide.
